what: Hovering a row in a text-only list (table) swaps that row’s photo instantly into a fixed frame beside the list (25% of screen width, a square at 16.67% from the left), and the frame follows the cursor height with .5s power3 (horizontal stays). On/off is .15s, and it turns off when leaving the list or scrolling

options.[data-fx-part=row]: Line — contains [data-fx-part=photo](hidden) one of them is the photo for that row

use: Work nameClient…
note: Not applied on touch devices (list only, no photo)

from.where: archive.html archive table — original ArchiveList.ts (quickTo y .5 power3, photo cloned per row, hidden on scroll · barba_leave)
